question.text: Under the Indian Majority Act 1875 read with the Guardians and Wards Act 1890, a "minor" is defined as a person who has not completed the age of:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the Indian Majority Act 1875, a minor is a person who has not completed the age of 18 years. The Guardians and Wards Act 1890 provides for the appointment of a guardian for such a minor — a person having the care of the minor's person or property. The Trap: Higher ages such as 21 or 25 may seem plausible, but the workbook anchors the definition at 18 years for the purposes of minor accounts and guardian/ward operations. Note: The 18-year threshold is what triggers guardian/ward arrangements under the Guardians and Wards Act for account operation purposes.
